command_or_source: bash scripts/test.sh with injected URLProtocol responses, file writer failures, malformed TOML, signal errors, and absent-process states.
result_summary: Covered HTTP 401/500, malformed and empty catalog payloads, duplicate catalog ids, ambiguous model assignments, live-file write failure with SQLite rollback, SIGKILL EPERM without relaunch, ESRCH as already exited, and Codex-not-running immediate launch. No failure path schedules process termination before dual-store success.
limitations: A real SQLite lock race and real filesystem exhaustion were not induced; the same error paths are covered through SQLite return handling and an injected failing writer.
A real NSWorkspace launch failure was not induced on the user's installed Codex application.
